title: Page 236
transc:
Beckwith & McCaine  Wash'n Nov 29th 1864
Hang Julia Nelson Ellsworth For Revenue Pearl Bowers Asst
Basket Bridle copy to Negus tulip Wardens succeeded in
reaching our agent by lower route last night and
returned Wheny yard they Watson that only Journals Quitman
of Kerners Princeton has gone to Horace Stick It
is rumored that Kirkwoods will end ever to Telegraph 
all his saints from the Wrangle yacht a Pilgrim
is expected shortly at Harvey and Woe Summer and
child men are being swindled from there and Gondola
to other Trinities for safe tee G. K. Leite


John Horner  Washn Novr 30th 1864
Gertrude Lamp for Mr Kennedy Supt Police
frog A man believed toby the man
described sligo france evening upton of Monday
as being the chief conspirator forth burning
of france is stephen old capital prison
send on a man to identify him
youth M wise well wily Govr &c
